verdict.rationale: Docs describe a self-serve, per-token pricing model for 100+ serverless models with no provisioning or sales contact needed, and community commenters independently quote specific per-token prices (e.g., $0.0001/1K tokens) confirming public visibility of pricing. However, no evidence pack item directly cites Together's pricing page or a full per-model price table, so completeness of 'every hosted model' listing is unverified. missing for 10: direct citation of the public pricing page/table covering all hosted models, confirmation that dedicated/fine-tuned model pricing is also public without sales contact.
